# Check: upstream tui-cell-size-input.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-cell-size-input.test.ts

## Subject
TUI handling of terminal cell-size responses at startup — ensures input is not lost when startup queries are in flight.

## Upstream test count (approx)
2

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- forwards bare escape even when a cell size query was sent at startup
- consumes cell size responses and still forwards later user input

## Upstream dependencies
getCellDimensions, resetCapabilitiesCache, setCellDimensions from ../src/terminal-image.js; Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal

## Upstream notes
Cell size response format: \\x1b[6;HEIGHT;WIDTH t. TUI queries cell size on startup when terminal supports images. setCellDimensions({widthPx, heightPx}) sets cached dimensions. getCellDimensions() returns them.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/stdin_fsm_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tui_render_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.
